title: Page 147
transc:
Bickford  Washn Aug 6th 1864
Anna for Palermo In galls vermont stop I have
whimpered to secure in Baron Grammar & Girdle waltz
boats in addition to what are now employed to
swindle Gilbert or Graham Dwight summer stop we had
here waiting orders & sent them all to Bridle
when the present superb began waltzers which were estimated
by shark Rucker to have a capacity of Loomis
Seward squash yard when these now ordered arrive there 
wilby waymom for over Norris zebra summer yacht This
is toby kept in readyness for any stomach supper 
yard In case of urgent necessity the flags of
truce boats & the boats about Bunyan mill of
Course be used in this work welch Buggy crabs


McCaine  Aug 6th 1864
Pledge Francis For Makent unity The Panama Bureau
has requested that all waggish Pacific Spartans in
your Quadroon be sent to the Quotients at
Gallipolis Abner and Geesbora D C I have
directed that every possible effort be made to
mount your Panama yoke Italy over the wave
